findings.claim: Changing the shared current_marker() to codeforge@1 changes --project-hooks output, contradicting the requirement that its behavior and output remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: The supplied patch_hooks implementation calls current_marker() before selecting global or project entries and passes that marker into both branches. P2 changes that function unconditionally, while the plan declares all --project-hooks changes out of scope.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan §2.5, P2 step 4, §7; src/cli/install.rs::patch_hooks and current_marker
findings.repair: Explicitly scope the fixed install-contract marker to global installation and preserve the existing project marker generation and output. Add a project-output regression assertion covering the marker as well as command strings.

findings.affected_surface: P2 step 2; hook CLI argument parsing and process exit handling
findings.claim: The proposed hook handler does not establish that argument-parsing failures avoid exit code 2.
findings.evidence: P2 declares a required name through clap attributes and specifies exit handling only after hook::run returns. A missing name can fail during clap parsing before that handler executes; clap's ordinary argument-error exit is 2. The proposed tests cover unknown names and child exit 7, but omit this boundary.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan P2 steps 1, 2 and 8; frozen rubric R11
findings.repair: During implementation, explicitly map parsing failures for the hook invocation to exit 1 and test the compiled binary with a missing hook name, malformed invocation, materialization failure, and child exit 2. Preserve exit 2 only when it originates from the child script.

findings.affected_surface: plan KR1 and P2.8 assertions over patch_hooks(global) command strings
findings.claim: KR1／P2.8 把 R1 的驗收寫成每條 global hook command 都不含斜線，與 P2.3 既有 entry 原樣保留衝突，P2 無法同時綠。
findings.evidence: 現行 global SessionEnd／SessionStart 已寫入 codeforge dream --quiet 2>/dev/null || true、codeforge ship --no-hook 2>/dev/null || true、codeforge memory context --hook 2>/dev/null || true、codeforge mnemos-cli context --hook ... 2>/dev/null || true，command 字串含斜線。P2.3 規定這些 entry 不變。R1 禁止的是絕對路徑、$HOME、~ 與版號，並要求新 hook 與既有 PATH 形式一致；P2.8 卻寫逐條斷言不含 / 也不含 CARGO_PKG_VERSION。照字面實作不是驗收紅，就是去改不該動的 dream／ship 字串。
findings.evidence_reference: plan KR1, §2.5 R1, P2.3, P2.8; src/cli/install.rs patch_hooks global SessionStart/SessionEnd hook_entry strings
findings.repair: 改寫 KR1／P2.8：只斷言 emit-session／session-digest 為 codeforge hook … 且不含絕對路徑、$HOME、~、版號；既有 dream／ship／memory／mnemos-cli 字串維持現況（含 2>/dev/null）。禁止對全部 command 做 contains('/')。

findings.affected_surface: current_marker() shared by --project-hooks and global install; _installed_by in project .claude/settings.json
findings.claim: P2.4 改共用 current_marker() 會改掉 --project-hooks 寫出的 _installed_by，與 R3 輸出完全不變及 §7 不改 project-hooks 直接衝突；R2 又要求 marker 固定為 codeforge@1。
findings.evidence: src/cli/install.rs 的 current_marker() 現在是 MARKER_PREFIX 加 CARGO_PKG_VERSION，patch_hooks 在 project=true 與 false 都用同一顆 marker；patch_statusline 亦然。P2.4 把它改成常數 codeforge@1，沒有 project／global 分流。R3 與 §7 寫 --project-hooks 行為與輸出完全不變。若不在計畫裡切開範圍，實作 P2 無法同時滿足 R2 與 R3。
findings.evidence_reference: plan R3 in §2.5, P2.4, §7 Out of scope; src/cli/install.rs current_marker, patch_hooks, run_install_project_hooks
findings.repair: 二選一寫進 P2／§7：(a) R3 只鎖 command 與 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} 形式，_installed_by 改為 codeforge@1 是 R2 允許例外（sweep 仍 starts_with('codeforge@')）；(b) marker 改為參數，project 模式繼續寫 codeforge@<CARGO_PKG_VERSION>。

findings.affected_surface: run() statusLine/subagentStatusLine command selection for shared vs local settings
findings.claim: 共用檔 statusLine 必須跨機器／版本都是 codeforge statusline，但選擇邏輯放在 run()，KR2 測試只打 patch_statusline 的既給 cmd，鎖不住 R9。
findings.evidence: 現況 run() 固定 format('{} statusline', exe_str) 寫入絕對路徑。P2.5 才依 is_shared() 與 PATH 是否命中 current_exe 改短形式。P2.8 的 KR2 是同一輸入連跑兩次 patch_hooks + patch_statusline；測不到 chooser。P2 e2e 只要求 hook command 以 codeforge 開頭，未斷言 statusLine。
findings.evidence_reference: plan P2.5, P2.8, KR2, KR1 e2e; src/cli/install.rs run() install_statusline block
findings.repair: 抽出純函式選擇 statusLine／subagentStatusLine command：共用檔一律 codeforge statusline（subagent-statusline 同理）；單機 PATH 命中現行 binary 寫短形式，否則維持絕對路徑。用單元測試釘這三支。

findings.claim: dangling symlink 的回錯寫在 write_settings_atomic，dry-run 在寫入前回傳，會把斷連結當成空檔並印將寫入 JSON，給出假成功。
findings.evidence: load_settings 用 path.exists()；dangling symlink 時 exists 為 false，回空物件 {}。run() 在 dry_run 分支於 write_settings_atomic 之前 return Ok。P1.2 規定 canonicalize 失敗要回錯且不 rename 連結本身，這條在 --dry-run（含 bootstrap --dry-run）不會走到。
findings.evidence_reference: plan P1.2, P1.4; src/cli/install.rs load_settings path.exists branch, run() dry_run return, write_settings_atomic
findings.repair: run() 在 load 之後、dry-run 或實寫之前，對 symlink_metadata 為 symlink 且 canonicalize 失敗的路徑直接回錯，訊息含連結路徑與 read_link 目標；dry-run 與實寫走同一檢查。

findings.affected_surface: src/cli/hook.rs run() Result plus src/main.rs Hook subcommand exit mapping
findings.claim: 腳本 exit code 原樣轉發已寫清，但轉發器自身 Result::Err 與 clap 解析失敗如何變成行程碼未釘死，仍可能走出 2。
findings.evidence: P2.1 規定未知名稱、找不到 node、signal 中止回 1，且轉發器自身絕不回 2；main 只寫 std::process::exit(code)。run 簽名是 Result<i32>，Err 若走 anyhow 預設多為 1，但 clap 缺 name／用法錯誤預設是 2。Claude Code 呼叫路徑有 name，仍應把 materialize／spawn／wait 失敗測成 1 而不是 2。
findings.evidence_reference: plan P2.1, P2.2, KR6, R11 in §2.5
findings.repair: P2 補 main 對 Hook 的 match：Ok(code) 則 exit(code)；Err 一律印正體中文後 exit(1)。對 exec_script 測 stdin／argv／exit 7；另測 node 不存在與未知名稱為 1。clap 用法錯誤可維持 2，並註明不在 hook 執行路徑。
